newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Petsec says still aims to double yr output.
newsitem.headline: Petsec says still aims to double yr output.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Petsec Energy Ltd said on Tuesday that the group was still on course to double 1996 production in the 1997 calendar year.
"The company's aim to double production this year over that of 1996 is well on track," managing director Terry fern said in a statement accompanying the company's half year results.
Petsec earlier reported a net profit of A$13.98 million for the six months ended June 30, 1997, compared with A$9.48 million a year earlier.
